title: NegPlan will-not-implement ledger
description: The portable markdown ledger (.negplan.md) parsed into JSON. The plan opens as a will-not-implement list; every diff hunk must cite a will_implement entry it satisfies or it is held at the gate.

task.description: One-line description of the build request the agent is working on.

agent.description: Agent that drafted the ledger, e.g. claude-code.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the ledger was created.

status.description: drafting = ledger open; negotiating = human reviewing vetoes; gating = diffs being checked; done = closed.

will_implement.description: Scope the agent is allowed to write code for. Each diff hunk must cite one entry by id.

will_not_implement.description: Scope the agent considered and refuses to do, each with a one-line justification. Human may override a veto; overridden items move into will_implement.

gates.description: Audit log of every diff hunk the gate saw and its verdict.

rationale.description: Why this is out of scope.

overridden.description: True once the human vetoed the agent's veto.

hunk.description: The @@ hunk header from the unified diff.

entry_id.description: The will_implement entry id this hunk claims to satisfy, or null when none matched (creep).

verdict.description: allowed = matched an entry; creep = no entry, held; overridden = human forced a creep hunk through.

human_override.description: True if a human forced this hunk's verdict; null when the gate decided alone.
